units.text: INT. LIGHTHOUSE LAMP ROOM - NIGHT
A glass cage at the top of a hundred iron steps.
The great lens turns, throwing slow white blades across a storm-black sea.
Rain hammers the panes.
HARLAN VOSS (50s, rumpled trench coat, a gambler's patient eyes) lowers himself through the floor hatch, breathing hard.
Across the lens stands NELL STRAND (30s, sharp, soaked, a revolver steady in both hands).
That's far enough, Mr. Voss.
units.name: NELL

units.text: You've been a long climb, Miss Strand.
units.name: VOSS

units.text: The beam sweeps over them.
In the flash, a third figure: DOYLE (40s, keeper's oilskins, face cut and bloody) crouched behind the lamp mechanism, a flare gun in his fist.
Both of you, drop it. I swear I'll burn this tower down.
units.name: DOYLE

units.text: Nell swings her gun toward Doyle.
Voss lunges for Nell.
The three of them freeze as the beam passes, then the light goes out.
DARKNESS.
A scuffle, a gunshot, glass shattering.
The lamp grinds back to life.
Nell has Doyle's arm twisted behind him.
Voss holds the revolver, aimed at neither of them.
Now. Who wants to tell me where the ledger is?
units.name: VOSS

units.text: Doyle laughs, breathless, and nods at the sea.
Eighty feet down. Good luck.
units.name: DOYLE
